guard: `notify` reaches an agent as DATA and reaching it twice is safe: one create-only notice per addressee keyed by a derived id, an instant bound with the step so a retry rewrites the same bytes, a render that refuses a value it cannot put in one row, and an explicit sentence when there is nothing to render
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config implementations/runtime/smoke/mutations/mesh-notify.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd
why: Batch B2 (2026-09-03), from a full-code audit and two live seats. Two defects the existing
suite could not see: the notify instant was read from the clock on every pass (the suite's
handler has a FROZEN clock, so its retry cell wrote identical bytes by accident of the
fixture and a real retry refused with `conflict` forever), and an empty notice set rendered
as a bare column header that two independent seats read as a payload that failed to arrive.

mutations.name: the notify instant is read from the clock again on the retry
mutations.expectRed: the instant every notice carries is BOUND with the step, not left to the next clock read
mutations.cell: the instant every notice carries is BOUND with the step, not left to the next clock read
mutations.note: Measured 2026-09-03: KILLED. mesh-notify.smoke: 44 passed, 2 failed Named cell red: the instant every notice carries is BOUND with the step, not left to the next clock read

mutations.name: an empty notice set renders the bare column header again
mutations.expectRed: no notices states the fact IN WORDS, so the addressee reads `nobody told you anything`
mutations.cell: no notices states the fact IN WORDS, so the addressee reads `nobody told you anything`
mutations.note: Measured 2026-09-03: KILLED. mesh-notify.smoke: 44 passed, 2 failed Named cell red: no notices states the fact IN WORDS, so the addressee reads `nobody told you anything`

mutations.name: the discharge walks past a cancelled branch's notices
mutations.expectRed: the discharge withdraws it: the notice will not be delivered again
mutations.cell: the discharge withdraws it: the notice will not be delivered again
mutations.note: A notice is world state exactly as a live seat or an armed timer is; the discharge released those three and walked past this one, so a decision the run cancelled still reached its addressee.

mutations.name: the withdrawal is filed as if a turn had carried it
mutations.expectRed: and says which cancelled step withdrew it, rather than naming a turn that never carried it
mutations.cell: and says which cancelled step withdrew it, rather than naming a turn that never carried it
mutations.note: `by` is what a reader traces a notice through. A withdrawal that names a turn claims a delivery that never happened.
